design: Arm 1 stage 1, one scenario per call, seeds 1-50
classified_by: hand, reading each sentence against the behaviours the never-killed mutants require (thesis-work/experiments/triage/bio_enc.json)
note: Rows are the behaviours a test must exhibit to kill a surviving mutant, not generic test categories. A scenario counts only if it names the behaviour, not if it merely operates in the same function. `stimulus_only` records scenarios that set up the right situation without proposing anything that would observe the difference -- the stimulus/oracle split is the finding. Under this design every behaviour row is empty: asked for one test, the model proposes the round trip.

zero-length read (L76).needs: BIO_read(b, buf, 0) and check the return

cipher status query (L77).stimulus_note: name 'error conditions' in passing; neither names the status query or a bad decrypt

init flag observed (L80, L438).stimulus_note: assert that BIO_set_cipher initialises the context or returns success, which is the same setup with a different oracle

leak on free (L89, L93, L96).needs: a leak detector; not available in this harness

call-pattern oracle (L134, L180, L199).needs: a source BIO that records the size of each read

stream cipher, block size 1 (L140).stimulus_note: every scenario that names a cipher names AES-CBC

retry / non-blocking (L208, L233, L263,.needs: a peer that sets retry flags, then BIO_should_retry

sink returns exactly 0 (L254, L283).needs: a custom sink BIO whose write returns 0

short read, outl <= 256 (L199).needs: read in <=256-byte chunks from a full source
